location.zh: 赫尔卡星 第三层 荒地（雷雨天）

capture.zh: 雷伊只在雷雨天出现在赫尔卡星第三层荒地：每个整点开始的前10分钟左右（早期为每晚20:00-22:00）。打败雷伊获得雷伊的精元，孵化得到雷伊（2011年起精元只在周五至周日发放）。

strategy_notes.zh: 丽莎布布单挑：叶绿光束消强化 → 花粉多次降低雷伊命中 → 光合作用补血 → 花草能量强化3次 → 叶绿光束打死（每下约500）；或满级卡鲁克斯破攻、大地之力强化后爆裂极突刺（每下1000-1200，暴击直接秒）；或该隐暗影护盾与攻击循环。

engine_notes: Storm encounter: 雷伊 only appears while it is 雷雨天 on 赫尔卡星 (hourly window). The remake has no clock — treat as always available, or as a map event that can be triggered once per in-game 'storm'.

Traits per 7k7k 2011 雷伊解析: 无视速度 (encoded as always_moves_first: 雷伊 acts first regardless of speed), 免疫属性技能, 天生强化, 高miss率. 免疫属性技能 is encoded as immune_status; classic strategies still lowered its accuracy with 花粉, so stat drops are NOT blocked.
高miss率 comes from its 电闪光 (speed -1, accuracy -1) — no separate rule.
heal_full_below 100: 7k7k 2011 boss guide says '血低于100会补满血' — the last hit must take it from ≥100 HP to 0.
Level: 7k7k 2011 says it started at 55 and was raised by 5 each time it returned, 70 at the time of writing; 70 used.
Innate boost stats not stated; atk+1 spe+1 assumed (it must be cleared with 叶绿光束 / 日月皆伤 style moves).
source_note: 7k7k 2011 雷伊解析: 赫尔卡星3层 整点10分钟, 体力2000, 无视速度/免疫属性技能/天生强化/高miss; 7k7k 2011 boss list: Lv55→70, 血低于100补满.
